messages:
mia: Heads-up — final preflight for devex 0.9. Cutoffs: docs + changelog by EOD Thu, SDKs + sample apps by Fri noon. Need owners + blockers. @ash @devon @sam

ash: I'm ok to own SDKs (Go + Python). PRs ready but waiting reviews: #412, #419. Need final build matrix from eng-runtime.

devon: I'll grab docs. Planning to freeze content by 18:00 Thu. Need a final list of new APIs and examples from devex.ash.

mia: @ash can you post list of API surface changes? Also who owns quickstarts?

ash: Quickstarts are mostly ready. @lee owns sample app infra — need her to confirm container image tags.

lee: Confirmed — sampleapp images will be pushed to gcr by Thu 15:00. Need the image tag list. Also I need the env var names for private deploy tests.

sam: I'm on call for release QA. Plan to smoke test SDKs + quickstarts Fri morning. Share matrix for OS/arch.

docs-bot: Automated reminder: changelog template is at https://redwood/docs/changelog-template.md

mia: Quick ownership recap: SDKs = ash, Docs = devon, Sample infra = lee, QA = sam. Any blockers?

ash: One blocker: API key rotation in hosted examples needs a sample change (PR #421). I'll target fix by Thu 12:00.

devon: Docs requires code snippets from #419; @ash can you merge that today?

lee: Will post tags by Thu 15:00 and confirm here.

sam: If all that lands, I can start smoke tests at 09:00 Fri. Please ping me after merge.

mia: OK, I'll update the release checklist and tags. Ping me if timing slips. :thumbsup:
